name: lying thoracic extensions on foam roller
description: Lying over a foam roller, you gently arch the upper back to open up the thoracic spine.
instructions: Lie on your back with the roller under your upper back.
Support your head with your hands.
Keep your hips on the floor and knees bent.
Gently lean back over the roller.
Return to neutral and shift the roller up or down.
Move slowly and breathe out as you extend.
